---
name: sequence_alignment
description: Domain knowledge for short-read alignment and post-alignment processing.
---

# Sequence Alignment

Domain knowledge for aligning short reads to a reference genome and
processing the resulting alignments.

## Expected Workflow

1. Check the dataset and assay facts first:
   - read layout
   - assay type
   - reference genome and index
   - whether downstream steps depend on pairing semantics
2. Choose an aligner and mode that match the assay instead of reusing a
   familiar default blindly.
3. Treat mapping rate and summary statistics as a sanity check on the
   reference and alignment mode.
4. Apply post-alignment filters deliberately and document what each one
   removes.
5. Accept the alignment branch only if sort order, indexing, and summary
   files all match the delivered BAM.

## Alignment Basics

- **Aligner choice matters**: Different aligners (Bowtie2, BWA, minimap2,
  HISAT2, STAR) have different sensitivity, speed, and intended use

events.command:
/usr/bin/bash -lc 'set -euo pipefail
# Build tab-separated id<TAB>seq<TAB>qual for input and retained output, then join on id.
for mate in forward reverse; do
  if [ "$mate" = forward ]; then in=/workspace/data/inputs/short_reads/pair/forward/forward.fastqsanger.gz; out=/workspace/final_answer/filtered_forward.fastqsanger.gz; else in=/workspace/data/inputs/short_reads/pair/reverse/reverse.fastqsanger.gz; out=/workspace/final_answer/filtered_reverse.fastqsanger.gz; fi
  gzip -cd "$in" | awk '"'NR%4==1 {id="'$0; sub(/''^@/,"",id); sub(/'"\\/[12]"'$/,"",id); getline s; getline p; getline q; print id "'"\\t\" s \"\\t\" q}' | sort -k1,1 > /tmp/"'${mate}_input.tsv
  gzip -cd "$out" | awk '"'NR%4==1 {id="'$0; sub(/''^@/,"",id); sub(/'"\\/[12]"'$/,"",id); getline s; getline p; getline q; print id "'"\\t\" s \"\\t\" q}' | sort -k1,1 > /tmp/"'${mate}_output.tsv
  join -t $'"'\\t' -1 1 -2 1 /tmp/"'${mate}_input.tsv /tmp/${mate}_output.tsv > /tmp/${mate}_joined.tsv
  awk -F '"'\\t' '"'$2!=$4 || $3!=$5 {bad++; print "BAD", $1; exit} END{if(!bad) print "'"'\""'$mate"'"' all retained records match original sequence/quality\"}' /tmp/"'${mate}_joined.tsv
  wc -l /tmp/${mate}_input.tsv /tmp/${mate}_output.tsv /tmp/${mate}_joined.tsv
done'
